$comment: US GENIUS covenant: a payment stablecoin is never described as earning or yielding. ONE source for both walls (apps/web genius-stablecoin-wall.test.ts and the apps/sandbox mirror in messages.test.ts), so they cannot drift (register 5.749). Patterns may only WIDEN: a narrowing is a covenant relaxation. A pairing = an earn-word within 40 characters of a stablecoin word, case-insensitive, across line breaks (the s flag, 2026-11-11). Widened 2026-11-11 (register 5.871, founder DR-2026-11-11-market-cleanup-decisions 3c): return|retorno|rentab and the pt-BR/es verbs ganhar/ganar, which the pt-BR/es copy used where English says earn. Second widening 2026-11-11 (W-B review): retorn (retorna/retornar), the Spanish rinde/rindió, interest/juros/interés/Zins/APY, and the stablecoin names USDS, USDT, DAI, PYUSD, USD Coin, stable coin. Third widening 2026-11-12 (W-B/W-C audit): a stated yearly rate ('5% a year', '5 % ao ano', '5 % al año', '5 % anual', '5 % pro Jahr', '5 % p.a.') counts as an earn claim beside a stablecoin word, plus remuner…, lucro, gains, Gewinn, Ertrag, reward/recompens…, 'pays 4%'/'paga 4%', genera (a bare percentage or 'pays' alone would flag the fee rows: 'a diBoaS user pays you in digital dollars … 0.48%'; strings shown TOGETHER also count a bare percentage, GENIUS-COMBO-1); moeda estável, moneda estable, sDAI, USDe, EURC. Both walls normalise look-alike spaces and hyphens before testing. Fourth widening 2026-11-17 (register 5.811, plan P9, founder DR-2026-11-17-p9-genius-lexicon-decisions, LC-RR-01-01): the whole class of return wording in en, pt-BR, es and de: growth verbs (grow, cresce, crece, wächst, wuchs, gewachsen), the verb compound (the protocol is excluded only when written Compound V<n> or compound.finance; 'the Compound protocol' pairs and would fail loudly), profit/profitable, accrual, APR (case-insensitive, D6), multiply/multiplier, appreciation (apreci…, valoriz…), German compounds (Zuwachs, Vermehrung, Wertsteigerung), rate notations after a percent sign or a spelled-out percent/por cento/por ciento/Prozent (a.a., a.m., TAE, TIN, a month, a day, yearly, por ano, mensal, pro Monat, täglich, …), income and payout words (passive income, extra income, renda extra, proventos, dividend, payout, cashback, renta, Belohnung, Prämie, …), value rising (increase in value, aumenta de valor, steigt im Wert), bounded 'generate <income|value|…>' in every tense and 'pays (you) every…', savings rate, and 'accumulate value'. earnNear (D2) holds the growth NOUNS (growth, crescimento, crecimiento, Wachstum) and bonus (bonuses, Boni, bonificação/bonificación): they count only inside the 40-character window, never across strings shown together (GENIUS-COMBO-1 reads earn only), because they are also everyday labels (the Growth strategy category). Left out on purpose (D3, scope limits in GENIUS-WALL-1): multiple (ordinary copy: 'multiple strategies'), accumulate unless followed by value/valor/Wert (the user's own saving), monthly income/renda mensal (the user's own income in Money Jobs), profitieren (benefits from), plain dollars/dólares (US currency, not a stablecoin), the idiom 'put … to work' (Legal's judgement, register 5.960). Rules for editing: \b and \w are ASCII-only (the walls use no u flag): never put \b next to an accented letter (creció\b never matches) and write [\wà-ÿ] where a word may carry an accent (\w* stopped at 'acumuló'); bound every repetition that precedes a required word ({0,12}, not *: an unbounded \w*\s+ took 10 s on 200k characters); every alternative is pinned by controls run in the real walls (a Python scan is not evidence of JavaScript behaviour); config/genius-wall-controls.json nonEarnForms is a ceiling: its entries are removed only by a founder ruling (the CI step prints a warning for a removed entry; it does not block); a CI step (scripts/check-genius-controls-grow.mjs, register 5.958) fails any control that disappears against the pull request's base.
